scene: Across the bridge, a bustling alley offers strange sights.
picture: A flat side view of a brick alleyway. On the far left hums a turquoise vending machine. An elderly East Asian man in a blue flat cap and orange cardigan leans on his wooden cane left of centre. Centre, a robotic silver cat sits upon a wooden crate. A narrow doorway beckons far right.
shown: a glowing turquoise vending machine dispensing mystery eggs on the far left
a silver mechanical cat sitting politely on a wooden crate centre
a narrow wooden doorway under a lantern on the far right

variants.scene: Warm paper lanterns glow above the lively alley as twilight settles in.
Humming {tune}, you wander past cozy shops into the evening crowd.
The brick street bustles with shoppers under the soft purple dusk.
